grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: Lin Tao's Weekday Morning
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方考试。请先读短文，再回答问题。单选题请选一个完整答案；填空题请用短文中的原词，不超过字数限制。所有解释为中文。
passage:
A: I am Lin Tao. I work in a small shop in Beijing. I get up at six every morning. I eat bread and drink milk. I go to work at seven.

B: My friend Wang Mei works with me. We start work at eight. We have lunch at twelve. We finish at five. After work, we walk home together.

C: In the evening, I read books. Sometimes I watch TV. I go to bed at ten. I like my simple day.

questions.prompt: 林涛每天早上几点起床？
questions.explanation: 短文说“I get up at six every morning.”，所以是六点。
questions.evidence: I get up at six every morning.

questions.explanation: 短文说“I eat bread and drink milk.”，所以是面包。
questions.evidence: I eat bread and drink milk.

questions.explanation: 短文说“I go to work at seven.”，所以是七点。
questions.evidence: I go to work at seven.

questions.prompt: 林涛和王梅几点开始工作？
questions.explanation: 短文说“We start work at eight.”，所以是八点。

questions.prompt: 林涛和王梅几点吃午饭？请填数字英文单词。
questions.explanation: 短文说“We have lunch at twelve.”，所以填 twelve。

questions.prompt: 下班后，林涛和王梅一起做什么？请填一个动词短语（两个词）。
questions.explanation: 短文说“After work, we walk home together.”，所以填 walk home。
questions.evidence: After work, we walk home together.

questions.explanation: 短文说“In the evening, I read books.”，所以是读书。
questions.evidence: In the evening, I read books.

questions.explanation: 短文说“I go to bed at ten.”，所以是十点。
questions.evidence: I go to bed at ten.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 说每天或经常做的事，用动词原形。主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词不变。例如“I get up”“We start”。时间词 at six、at eight 放在句末。

questions.prompt: 选择正确句子：我每天七点去上班。
options: I go to work at seven every day.
I goes to work at seven every day.
I going to work at seven every day.
answers: I go to work at seven every day.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 go。
questions.evidence: I go to work at seven.

questions.prompt: 选择正确句子：我们八点开始工作。
questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 start。

questions.prompt: 填空：They ____ (finish) at five. 请填一个词。
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，动词用原形 finish。

questions.prompt: 填空：You ____ (walk) home. 请填一个词。
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，动词用原形 walk。
questions.evidence: After work, we walk home together.

part1: What time do you get up?

speaking.part2: Describe your weekday morning. You should say:
part3: Do you walk to work or school?

Do you watch TV in the evening?

transfer.writing: 写 5 个简单句，介绍你的一天。用 I get up... / I eat... / I go to... / I finish... / I go to bed... 这些句型。每句用一般现在时。
